name: Outlet
description: Free peer support groups and sliding-scale counseling for LGBTQ+ youth and families
fullDescription: Outlet, a program of Adolescent Counseling Services in Redwood City, offers LGBTQIA+ affirming counseling, free peer support groups, and school and community education for young people and their families.
whatTheyOffer:
- LGBTQIA+ affirming individual, couple, and family counseling (ages 5-25)
- Free drop-in peer support and social groups (ages 10-25)
- GSA/Pride Club support for schools
- SOGIE 101 trainings and workshops
- Community consultations and resource referrals
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the bilingual screening form on the Outlet webpage to ask about counseling
2. Or call 650-424-0852 (intake ext. 108) or email outletprogram@acs-teens.org
3. Drop-in groups are free and need no registration
4. Counseling uses a sliding fee scale; Outlet does not take insurance or Medi-Cal but can provide superbills
address: 1779 Woodside Road, Suite 200, Redwood City, CA 94061
keywords: Outlet, Adolescent Counseling Services, ACS, San Mateo, Redwood City, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, youth counseling, family counseling, peer support groups, GSA, ages 5-25
